reference.purpose: Repository asset sheet used as the visual reference

notes: The reference sheet combines multiple visual elements in one image.
Use it as the visual source of truth; export or recreate required elements as separate files.
The whole sheet should not be used as a single website image.

assets.use: Hero mascot illustration with laptop, books, and code bubble
Brand mark, navigation, project cards, theme control, and GitHub
Pastel hero gradients, sparkles, borders, and surfaces

css_html_elements: Navigation, buttons, project cards, borders, shadows, and rounded corners
Light and dark theme colors, gradients, and responsive backgrounds
All text, headings, project descriptions, status labels, and technology tags
Responsive layout for desktop and Android-sized screens
production_rules: Keep the approved simple Octo-cat silhouette, cream face, rounded tentacles, and lavender palette.
Use the standalone SVG files on transparent backgrounds; do not place the black asset-sheet background on the website.
Keep navigation and project icons as inline SVG so they remain crisp and lightweight.
Keep text and interactive UI in HTML/CSS, not baked into images.
Test both themes and mobile layouts before publishing.
production_order: Review Octo-cat SVG on light and dark backgrounds
Review responsive layout on Android-sized screens
Verify language, theme, Ko-fi, email, project links, and terminal easter egg
acceptance_checks: No CSS or HTML reference to background_earth.jpg
Octo-cat hero and favicon load from repository SVG files
Light and dark theme toggle works and persists
Language selection works for English, Indonesian, Filipino, Chinese, and Japanese
Mobile navigation and Ko-fi popup work
Project links and email link point to intended destinations
